colors.description: Deep Obsidian background (#050505) paired with Pure White text for maximum contrast. Volt Green (#E6FF00) used purely as a kinetic trigger for highlights and important accents.

visual_enhancers: High-contrast monochromatic or duotone photography treatment (using CSS grayscale and contrast filters).
Subtle CSS noise/grain overlay spanning the entire site background to give a gritty, tactile sportswear feel.
Sharp 1px borders (tactical minimalism) instead of soft box-shadows.
components_needed: framer-motion (for line-by-line kinetic hero text and scroll reveals)
grids_and_layouts: Tetris Grid for the Gallery and Manifesto sections (asymmetrical, large gaps like gap-8 or gap-12).
No standard centering: left-align massive text, use negative space aggressively to build tension.

motion.hero: Staggered line-by-line text reveal from bottom up using framer-motion. Very slow, deliberate timing.
motion.scroll: Elements fading and sliding up slightly as they enter viewport using framer-motion whileInView.
motion.marquee: Continuous loop, either massive outline text (Kinetic Texture) or an elegant spaced-out editorial ribbon.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast on small text. When overlaying hero text on background images, use bg-black/60 or gradient overlays to ensure legibility.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (links, emails, phone numbers).

sections.name: Header/Nav
sections.description: Sticky top bar with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60), academy logo on the left, email/phone contact on the right. No hamburger menu, just clean text links.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Kinetic typography reveal of 'BELGIUM ELITE ACADEMY'. Background is dark floodlit stadium. Subheadline in French explaining the path to pro. No forms.

sections.name: Marquee
sections.description: Editorial slow-scroll ribbon with key phrases: 'TRAIN LIKE A PRO • BOOSTER VOTRE CARRIÈRE • U17-U23 • ÉLITE'.

sections.name: Manifesto
sections.description: Numbered chapters (01. La Méthode, 02. Pour Qui, 03. Le Parcours Pro). Large numbers, sharp borders, bold short paragraphs. Left-aligned.

sections.name: Gallery
sections.description: Bento-style or asymmetrical masonry grid of U17-U23 training photos. Images treated with high contrast and slight grayscale to match the elite tone.

sections.name: Contact / Footer
sections.description: Massive typography displaying Email and Phone number. Clean, brutalist layout for direct contact.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize standard Tailwind config with dark mode as default background.
Add the Google Fonts import to index.css and extend the Tailwind config to use 'Anton' and 'Inter'.
Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling at the root App level.
Strictly follow the Dark / Athletic aesthetic. DO NOT use rounded bubbly buttons; use sharp, tactical minimalism (0px or 2px max border radius).
For the hero background image, place it in an absolute positioned div with object-cover and a strong bg-black/60 overlay to allow the white kinetic text to pop.
Use Framer Motion to create the line-by-line reveal in the hero.
All text must be in French.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use ONLY the provided image_urls.
Implement react-fast-marquee for the animated text band.
Ensure the layout is perfectly responsive on both mobile and PC.
Ensure 'data-testid' is on all crucial readable text and interactive parts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; no fully transparent backgrounds under text.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
MUST NOT center align the App container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12, p-16) for premium feel.
